title: Gear Ratios
description: Find part numbers adjacent to symbols and gear ratios for '*' symbols.
writeup:
## Approach

Use regex to find all multi-digit numbers and their positions in each row. For each number, check all neighboring cells for symbols.

## Part 1

A number is a "part number" if any of its digits is adjacent (including diagonally) to a symbol (anything that isn't `.` or a digit). Sum all part numbers.

## Part 2

A gear is a `*` symbol adjacent to exactly two part numbers. Track which numbers are adjacent to each `*`, then sum the products of pairs.
